description: The plot illustrates the training loss of various models over a number of steps, with the x-axis representing the number of steps and the y-axis representing the training loss. The plot shows that the ChemBERTa Small 20M model exhibits the steepest decline in training loss, reaching approximately 0.15 at 440k steps. The ChemLLaMA Medium 20M model consistently outperforms the ChemBART Medium 20M model, achieving the lowest loss of all models at 0.01. The ChemBART Small 20M model shows a slower rate of decline compared to the ChemLLaMA Small 20M model, stabilizing at around 0.25 at 440k steps.
